dict.string: ReMeet records your microphone during meetings so your side of the conversation can be transcribed on this Mac.
ReMeet reads your calendar on this Mac to remind you to record a minute before a meeting and to name the recording after it. Nothing is changed or sent anywhere.
ReMeet syncs your meeting action items with your Apple Reminders lists (such as Work or Projects) and keeps completion status in sync on this Mac.

ReMeet records call audio playing on this Mac so the other participants can be transcribed on this Mac.
